published_implementation.note: The reported runs come from first-party release lineage 96ed93ba7ee0b9519fc55c963afb47a1975eb1ae. That lineage and the canonical review ref diverge in Git history; the canonical review ref contains the corresponding harness-disentangling and UnifiedEngine protocol surfaces.

observations.benchmark: A-Evolve harness-evolution study: SWE-bench Verified / MCP-Atlas / SkillsBench
observations.metric_note: The publication defines harness-updating capability as mean pairwise evolution gain across fixed anchor agents and reports pass-rate gains in percentage points. These values are preserved as a vector of reported observations, not collapsed into a single global capability score.
observations.comparability_limitation: This is a within-system quantitative study across three task domains and several evolver backbones, not a matched cross-harness comparison.
observations.provenance_limitation: The reported experimental runs come from the first-party harness-evolution release lineage at 96ed93ba7ee0b9519fc55c963afb47a1975eb1ae. That release lineage and canonical review ref 18ba996dac9843f2759b2cdf8a94022f58fbfeb9 diverge in Git history. The canonical review ref nevertheless contains the first-party harness-disentangling artifact and UnifiedEngine port implementing the published Exp0/Exp1 protocol. Preserve the result as first-party-reported historical evidence; it is not independently reproduced at the canonical review revision.
observations.non_claim: These heterogeneous gains are not a global harness score and do not determine downstream canonical organizational classifications.
adaptation_loop: operational agent executes the next task batch under the current harness
execution trajectories and outputs become evidence for the A-Evolve evolver
the fixed evolver procedure proposes and applies a persistent harness update
the updated harness becomes the next agent state
later task execution measures whether the changed persistent capability is useful
